documentation.file_docstring:
Trust-based routing component for Langflow flows.

Routes agent actions to one of three outputs based on trust score:
trusted (proceed), review (human review), or blocked (deny).
Uses decay-based trust with asymmetric reward/penalty.
member_docstrings: RouteDecision: Routing decision based on trust score.
TrustScore: Multi-dimensional trust score for an agent.

TrustRouter: Routes flow based on agent trust score.

Three outputs:
- trusted_output: agent
compute_overall: Compute weighted overall score from dimensions.
get_score: Get or create trust score for an agent.
route: Route based on current trust score.
record_success: Record a successful action, boosting specified dimensions.

classes.name: TrustRouter
classes.doc:
Routes flow based on agent trust score.

Three outputs:
- trusted_output: agent trust >= trusted_threshold
- review_output: review_threshold <= trust < trusted_threshold
- blocked_output: trust < review_threshold

Configurable thresholds and asymmetric reward/penalty rates.
